name: google-ads-playbook
description: Audit and rebuild a Google Ads account with the $100M GADs playbook. Read-only. Scripts compute leakage, misallocation, feed scores, and the 7/14/30-day scaling gate; skills orchestrate; Google's official MCP answers live questions.

developer_token.title: Google Ads developer token
developer_token.description: From the API Center of the manager account. Stored in your OS keychain. Needs Explorer access or better to read production accounts.

gcp_project_id.title: Google Cloud project ID
gcp_project_id.description: The project where the Google Ads API is enabled and the OAuth desktop client was created.

login_customer_id.title: Manager (MCC) customer ID
login_customer_id.description: Ten digits, no dashes. The manager account you access client accounts through.

adc_path.title: Path to adc.json
adc_path.description: Written by gads auth. Absolute path, no tilde. Default /Users/<you>/.config/google-ads-playbook/adc.json
